description: Defines the RenderSurface class interface for composing to a render surface within Android's SurfaceFlinger. Includes method declarations for surface validation, initialization, configuration, and rendering lifecycle management.

classes.name: RenderSurface
classes.description: Abstract interface for a render surface used in Android's composition engine, providing methods for validation, setup, configuration, and rendering lifecycle.

methods.name: ~RenderSurface
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the RenderSurface interface.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the render surface is valid for use.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Performs one-time setup of the render surface.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size bounds of the surface.

methods.name: isProtected
methods.description: Indicates if the surface is protected.

methods.name: getClientTargetAcquireFence
methods.description: Retrieves the latest fence signaling rendering completion.

methods.name: setDisplaySize
methods.description: Sets the display size of the surface.

methods.name: setBufferPixelFormat
methods.description: Sets the pixel format for the surface buffer.

methods.name: setProtected
methods.description: Configures whether the surface is protected.

methods.name: beginFrame
methods.description: Signals the start of rendering for a frame.

methods.name: dequeueBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a buffer for GPU composition.

methods.name: queueBuffer
methods.description: Queues the buffer for display consumption.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the state of the render surface for debugging.

methods.name: supportsCompositionStrategyPrediction
methods.description: Checks if client composition prediction is supported.
